scope: saved-output observational comparison; aggregate values only

definitions.chars: Actual body Unicode characters excluding whitespace.
definitions.exact_repetition: Longest contiguous exact common substring for each different call pair within the same topic, including whitespace; threshold20. Not a semantic repetition score.
definitions.named_places_brands: rootが全24本文を読み、実在する地名・施設・店舗/ブランドの出現を手動照合。一般物品名は数えず、出現話題数を数える。名詞数を自然さの点数にはしない。

limits: Different topics and CPU-selected sequences; not matched same-content A/B.
Five edited text topics from one reference speaker; no new audio listening or blind human scoring.
Exact textual repetition and semantic repetition are distinct.
Proper-name topic counts are manual descriptive evidence, not a naturalness score.
